# docker-torrent-box-with-vpn

> Torrent, Usenet, Servarr, media, and VPN stack using Docker Compose or
> Podman Compose.
> Apache License 2.0. Author: Ivan Pinatti (https://github.com/ivan-pinatti).
> Canonical repository: https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/docker-torrent-box-with-vpn

## What it does

docker-torrent-box-with-vpn is a Compose-based media automation stack. It runs
qBittorrent, optional Usenet tools, Servarr applications, Jellyfin, observability
services, and Nginx reverse proxying behind a single Gluetun VPN gateway.

The VPN design uses `network_mode: container:gluetun` for torrent, usenet, and
servarr services. This gives the stack a structural killswitch: if Gluetun stops,
the shared network namespace disappears and those services lose network access.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): Full setup, operation, support, and usage documentation
- [.env.example](.env.example): Main configurable variables and profile defaults
- [versions.env](versions.env): Every image version the stack runs, committed so `git pull` brings updates
- [docker-compose.yml](docker-compose.yml): Top-level Compose file and shared networks
- [docker-compose-vpn.yml](docker-compose-vpn.yml): Gluetun VPN gateway definition
- [docker-compose-servarr.yml](docker-compose-servarr.yml): Servarr services
- [docker-compose-torrent.yml](docker-compose-torrent.yml): qBittorrent services
- [docker-compose-nzb.yml](docker-compose-nzb.yml): Usenet downloader services
- [docker-compose-proxy.yml](docker-compose-proxy.yml): Nginx reverse proxy
- [docker-compose-observability.yml](docker-compose-observability.yml): Metrics and dashboards
- [docs/NETWORKING.md](docs/NETWORKING.md): Canonical network architecture and killswitch design
- [docs/VPN_PROVIDERS.md](docs/VPN_PROVIDERS.md): Gluetun provider guidance
- [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): Machine-readable citation metadata

## Tech stack

- Podman or Docker
- podman-compose or Docker Compose
- Gluetun for VPN tunneling, firewalling, DNS, and port forwarding
- Proton VPN by default, with documented alternatives through Gluetun
- qBittorrent
- Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, Bazarr, Prowlarr, Recyclarr, Whisparr
- Nginx reverse proxy
- Prometheus, Grafana, exporters, and Promtail
- GNU Make
